# prime-floatlabel

prime-rs: FloatLabel component (port of PrimeNG)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/floatlabel) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-floatlabel)

FloatLabel — port of `p-floatlabel` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Renders `<span class="p-floatlabel p-floatlabel-over|on|in">` with a nested field and `<label>`; the position and lift
of the label are set by the theme CSS according to the field state. The `/* For PrimeNG */` block (`.ng-invalid.ng-dirty`) is not needed here:
the color of an invalid value comes from the base rule `:has(.p-invalid) label`.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_floatlabel::{FloatLabel, FloatLabelVariant};

let html = view! {
    <FloatLabel variant=FloatLabelVariant::On><input class="p-inputtext" id="u" /><label for="u">"Name"</label></FloatLabel>
}.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-floatlabel p-floatlabel-on"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-floatlabel = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["floatlabel"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
